components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view, such as Approve or Sign for receipt.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #0b5560; border-radius: 3px; background: #0b5560; color: #ffffff; font: 600 14px/1 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0e6b78; border-color: #0e6b78; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b5560; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary action, such as Print or Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #c3cecf; border-radius: 3px; background: #ffffff; color: #0f1f22; font: 600 14px/1 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #66787b; background: #f5f7f7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b5560; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip (Matched)
components.description: Automated check result. Always carries its word; the dot repeats the colour.
components.css: .ds-chip-matched { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: #d4ecda; color: #0c3a1d; font: 600 12px/18px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1d6a3a; }

components.name: Boxed Field
components.description: Evidence, Checks and History panels: caps label tucked into the top-left corner.
components.html:
Evidence

Exact quote in its source.
components.css: .ds-field { border: 1px solid #c3cecf; border-radius: 3px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-field-label { margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px 0; font: 600 10.5px/14px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #465659; } .ds-field-body { margin: 0; padding: 6px 12px 12px; font: 400 14px/22px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0f1f22; }

components.name: Manifest Tally
components.description: Signature move: one tick per claim, coloured by what a person decided. Selected tick takes canary.
components.css: .ds-tally { display: flex; gap: 1px; height: 24px; align-items: stretch; } .ds-tick { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; border-radius: 1px; background: #d3dcdc; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tick:hover { transform: scaleY(1.1); } .ds-tick-approved { background: #1d6a3a; } .ds-tick-rejected { background: #b0244a; } .ds-tick-selected { background: #f4cf3f; outline: 2px solid #f4cf3f; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Role Card (Selected)
components.description: Selected role on the handover. Access label in canary on ink.
components.css: .ds-role { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #0e2f36; border-radius: 3px; background: #0e2f36; color: #eef4f3; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-role-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-role-access { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #f4cf3f; } .ds-role-desc { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; color: #a9c2c2; } .ds-role:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b5560; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Step (Active)
components.description: Active step in the ink header: canary number and a 3px canary underline.
components.html: 2Check the claims
components.css: .ds-step { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 14px; height: 100%; font: 600 13.5px/1 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #a9c2c2; text-decoration: none; } .ds-step-on { color: #eef4f3; } .ds-step-n { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #2a5560; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-on .ds-step-n { background: #f4cf3f; border-color: #f4cf3f; color: #4a3800; } .ds-step-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #f4cf3f; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4cf3f; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Receipt Stamp
components.description: Closes the handover after a person signs for receipt. Only place the stamp appears.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; border: 2px solid #1d6a3a; border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 16px; color: #1d6a3a; font: 800 18px/24px 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transform: rotate(-3deg); animation: ds-stamp-in 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-stamp-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.35) rotate(-6deg); filter: blur(2px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotate(-3deg); filter: blur(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stamp { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Backstop reads like a consignment note on a bill of lading: a form that travels with a load and must be signed for. The departing engineer's knowledge leaves with a declared manifest, and every line is inspected against its proof before it is released. The world is a shipping form made for review. An ink frame (deep blue-green header and footer) holds a cool paper ground. Content sits in white boxed panels with 1px hairlines and 2 to 4px corners, and every field carries its small caps label tucked into its top-left corner.

Density is working density. A lead scans a long manifest with a proof excerpt beside it; a newcomer reads a short role-limited plan and signs. Almost nothing is decorative. The one flourish is the rotated receipt stamp, which appears only after a person signs for receipt. Depth comes from hairlines and tone, not shadow; shadows exist only under overlays such as dialogs and the action toast. Missing evidence is shown as a question, never filled in.

Confirmed rejections: the blue card-grid SaaS dashboard, and its dark-terminal opposite.
keyCharacteristics: Ink frame (blue-green header and footer) around a cool paper ground.
Boxed fields with the label in the box's top-left corner.
Status carried in four colours, each paired with its own word.
Verbatim quotes, line numbers, IDs and form numbers in a monospace face.
A tally strip, one tick per claim, is the signature; the stamped receipt closes it.

rules.name: The Canary Marks Attention Rule
rules.body: Canary is the one thing under inspection: the selected line, the highlighted quote, the active step. It is never a status colour.

rules.name: The Caps Are Boxed Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked caps belong to the boxed-field label and to the receipt stamp. Section titles and navigation are sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Until Overlaid Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only when something floats above the page, and it is tinted with ink.

rules.name: The Proof Beside the Claim Rule
rules.body: Every claim shows its quote or its calculation in the same view as its text. A claim with no stored proof reads "Treat it as unproven" and is not dressed up as verified.

rules.name: The Stamp Is Earned Rule
rules.body: The rotated stamp appears only on the signed receipt, after a person has signed for it. It is never used as decoration elsewhere.

dos: Do put the quote or calculation beside every claim, in mono, with a Canary mark on the matched text.
Do show missing evidence as a question in the Missing chip, never as filled-in text.
Do carry status in a chip with its word, not colour alone.
Do keep depth as a 1px Hairline, a tonal step, and the corner radius.
Do use one Form Teal primary action per view.
donts: Don't use Canary as a status colour; it marks what is under inspection.
Don't add a shadow to a resting panel, card or table; shadows belong only to the dialog and the toast.
Don't round any container beyond 4px; status dots are the only round marks.
Don't use Carbon Pink for anything except conflicting, rejected and restricted claims.
Don't set verbatim text, line numbers or IDs in the sans face.
Don't rotate the receipt stamp anywhere but on the signed receipt.
